## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Bug Fixes**

## Walkthrough
Test runner stops ignoring three trace files. Host call logging now prints enum names for result codes. Interpreter removes TRAP gas subtraction on abnormal instruction termination while keeping status mapping unchanged.

## Changes
| Cohort / File(s) | Summary of changes |
| --- | --- |
| **Test runner config**<br>`bin/test-runner/jam-conformance-067.ts` | Removed three trace entries from the ignored list; those traces will now execute in tests. No logic changes. |
| **Interpreter and host calls**<br>`packages/core/pvm-interpreter/interpreter.ts`, `packages/core/pvm-host-calls/host-calls.ts` | Interpreter: eliminated TRAP gas deduction on FAULT/FAULT_ACCESS; status mapping logic remains. Host calls: log result using enum name (`PvmExecution[result]`) instead of numeric code when defined. |

## Sequence Diagram(s)
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  actor Caller
  participant Interpreter
  participant GasMeter
  participant ISA as Instruction Exec
  note over Interpreter: Execute single instruction

  Caller->>Interpreter: step()
  Interpreter->>ISA: run()
  ISA-->>Interpreter: { status, ... }

  alt status = HALT
    Interpreter->>Interpreter: this.status = HALT
  else status = FAULT or FAULT_ACCESS
    note right of Interpreter: Removed: TRAP gas subtraction
    par (No TRAP gas deduction)
      Interpreter->>GasMeter: (no-op)
    and
      Interpreter->>Interpreter: this.status = (FAULT→FAULT, FAULT_ACCESS→PANIC)
    end
  else status = PANIC
    Interpreter->>Interpreter: this.status = PANIC
  else status = HOST
    Interpreter->>Interpreter: this.status = HOST
  end
```

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  participant HostCalls
  participant Logger
  participant Enum as PvmExecution Enum

  HostCalls->>HostCalls: compute result (number | undefined)
  alt result is defined
    HostCalls->>Enum: map code → name
    Enum-->>HostCalls: enumName
    HostCalls->>Logger: "Status(enumName)"
  else result is undefined
    HostCalls->>Logger: "Result"
  end
```
